name: ANSI/IEEE on-delay normally-open contact symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for on-delay normally-open contact, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The on-delay NO contact form specifically describes a delayed-closing transition. Its timer reference supplies the initiating condition and interval, while the unoperated contact remains open; release or reset behaviour comes from the documented timing chart.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Separate the delay-close transition from the contact's return action.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A timed output contact differs from the timer coil or trigger that initiates its timing.
